name: code-language
description: Syntax coloring, diagnostics and formatting for the Code programming language (.code files) — driven by the code-lsp server built from the very code release you have.

codelanguage.server.path.markdownDescription: Path to a `code-lsp` binary to serve `.code` files. Leave empty to use the server compiled from this repository and shipped inside the extension, which always matches the `code` version in this extension's description. As a last resort the extension looks for `code-lsp` on `PATH` and says so in a warning, because a server from another vintage would answer about a different language than the one these documents describe.

codelanguage.trace.server.markdownDescription: Traces the communication between VS Code and the Code language server (the LSP messages themselves).
